notice: Frozen values for the T-3247 POISSON.DIST pmf fresh sweep, written 2026-11-11 before any value returned. Research metadata, NOT oracle values. engine_today is what the engine returns (off the saddle point: EXP of k LN(mean) - GAMMALN(k + 1) held in a register, times EXP(-mean); above a mean of 1.1 at k >= 2: the saddle point). candidate is the form this sweep tests, EXP(S)(1 + err) with S the stored sum (k LN(mean) - mean) - GAMMALN(k + 1) and err its two rounding errors, from the reference model on Excel's own GAMMALN cells; it is NOT in the engine. The two next fields are its closest rivals on the cached cells (36 and 11 of 38 at k >= 2, against 38). saddle_point is the kernel of the other branch, which Excel takes above a mean of 1.1 at k >= 2: on sheet Switch it and the candidate are the two answers to where the switch is; on sheet One it is the rival of "k = 1 is the closed form at any mean". engine_with_the_candidate is the engine built with the candidate in its closed branch and its switch left at a mean of exactly 1.1 (a scratch build, not committed): the candidate on every row of sheets Small and One and on the rows of sheet Switch at a mean of 1.1, the saddle point above it.
